reason: The skill-script Tool entry (TrustedSkillScriptToolProvider) is not on the consumed SDK baseline yet, so the SH runtime only exposes the generic execution_run tool and the skill script tool name / materialization semantics are undeclared. Rerun this profile after 038-32 merges and the baseline re-publishes; the runner AllowedNotRun list, the spec gate and the SHPM dependency posture all read this single manifest.

assertions.A1: 审批拒绝不启进程：技能脚本 Tool 为 ALWAYS 审批；拒绝后既无该 Tool 的执行结果，也无任何进程启动。
assertions.A2: 依赖摘要漂移拒绝：冻结技能包物化前的逐文件摘要校验，任一依赖文件漂移即在执行入口拒绝（上游 038-32 §3.1 反例）。
assertions.A3: 多文件包相对导入解析成立，入口文件身份（脚本以文件路径而非 stdin 执行）成立（§3.1 正例）。
assertions.A4: 超时/取消终结整个进程树，无孤儿进程（含 Windows 子树）。
assertions.A5: 输出越界路径（outputs/ 之外）被拒绝，且不发布 Artifact。
assertions.A6: 产物落当前 Run 的 outputs/，Artifact ID/provenance 可信，下载字节 SHA-256 与落盘文件一致。
assertions.A7: 跨 Run/跨 Thread 隔离：Run A 的产物不出现在 Run B。
assertions.A8: 运行时未声明或预检失败 fail closed，使用稳定错误码。

cases: A1 approval denial starts no skill script process
A2 dependency digest drift rejects skill package materialization
A3 multi-file package resolves relative imports and entry-file identity
A4 timeout and cancellation terminate the whole process tree
A5 output outside outputs is rejected and publishes no artifact
A6 run artifact lands in outputs with verifiable download SHA-256
A7 cross-Run isolation keeps artifacts thread-scoped
A8 undeclared runtime fails closed with a stable error code
